title: Problem Solving & Coding Patterns in Go
intro: Problem-solving and coding patterns in Go cover the programs every Go fresher is asked to write in a screening. This module teaches seven familiar problems with idiomatic Go: FizzBuzz, Fibonacci, palindrome and anagram checks, Two Sum, rune-safe string reversal, and word counting. Each lesson explains the invariant, follows a concrete input, compares useful alternatives, and shows the Go operation that matters. The aim is to understand why the algorithm works and then choose bytes, runes, maps, loops, or library helpers from the actual input contract.
